senses.gloss: f. (קְלַף) peel, husk; thin skin (gut for sausages).—Pl. קְלוּפְיָיתָא, קְלוּפְיָיתָה.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 7:2:27">Y. Sabb. VII, 10ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>כד מבחר בק׳</he> when he makes a selection from among the guts; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 7:2:27">ib.</cite> <he>בקלופיתיה</he> (corr. acc.). [Levy, Neuhebr. Wört. quotes <he>קְלִיפַיָּיא</he>.]
